text:
maria: FYI found a UX hole in the JS onboarding sample -- when you paste a bad API key the UI keeps retrying and never surfaces an actionable error. users get stuck.
kevin: huh. is that because the SDK retry policy treats all failures as retryable?
maria: yep. repro steps: `git clone && npm i && API_KEY=bad npm start` then open the console. logs show repeated 401 retries.
toni: that's rough. 4xx (except 429) should be non-retryable and surfaced as typed errors (AuthError / ClientError).
ciara: Agreed. For SDK parity we should export consistent classes across languages: AuthError, RateLimitError, ClientError, ServerError, TransientError.
kevin: Proposal: error envelope = { name, status_code, code, message, retryable, details? } where details is freeform string. Sampleapps can switch on `name`.
maria: Love the envelope idea. Also include `user_hint` for UI copy so we don't show raw HTTP bodies. e.g. user_hint: "Check API key or reauthenticate".
toni: Telemetry request: set `error_class` tag (auth/rate/perm/server) so dashboards can roll up.
ciara: Small compatibility note: older SDKs throw `Error` with `status`. We need a migration plan: patch minor to add typed classes but keep old fields.
kevin: Implementation checklist I propose:
- SDK: classify 401/403 -> AuthError (retryable=false)
- SDK: 429 -> RateLimitError with `retry_after`
- SDK: 5xx -> TransientError (retryable=true)
- SDK: include `raw_body` truncated + `original_status` if proxying upstream
- Sampleapps: stop retry spinner for non-retryable errors and show CTA

maria: For immediate mitigation I'll update the sampleapp to bail on 4xx and show a clear banner with CTA. PR incoming.
ciara: Please include a unit test that stubs a 401 and asserts AuthError thrown and no retry attempts.
toni: Edgecase: some auth flows use refresh token and may get a 401 then token refresh succeeds. We need to ensure SDK refresh logic runs before classifying as AuthError. Order of ops: attempt token refresh -> if still 401 then AuthError (non-retryable).
kevin: Good point. Document that in SDK docs. Also recommend `retryable` semantics: boolean + optional `retry_after_seconds` for 429.
maria: Drafted UI snippet for docs:
```js
try {
  await client.complete(...)
} catch (err) {
  if (err.name === 'AuthError') return showRelogin();
  if (err.name === 'RateLimitError') return showRateLimit(err.retry_after_seconds);
  if (err.retryable) return retryWithBackoff();
  showGenericError(err.user_hint || 'Something went wrong');
}
```
ciara: Nice. Also add a changelog entry and a short note in the onboarding checklist so new hires don't file duplicate issues.
kevin: I'll open an RFC PR that defines the error envelope and lists migration guidance for python/js/go. link it from the SDKs repo.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/358 contains the sampleapp guard and tests. cc @ciara @toni.
toni: Reviewing now. one nit: let's truncate `raw_body` to 4k chars to avoid logging secrets.
ciara: ack on truncation. Also add an env var to toggle including raw_body for debugging only.
bot-ci: reminder: please add a unit test and CI job ensuring no infinite retry loops for 4xx (https://ci.redwood.company/pipelines/123).
maria: thanks all. will follow up with RFC link and sampleapp deployment note. :sparkles:
